{{Quote|<nowiki />''Admiral Nict'' of the ''Pride of Corellia'' on the holo, Admiral.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaius Yorub]], to Admiral Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy21" />}}
The '''''Pride of Corellia''''' was a [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] [[YZ-2500 heavy transport]] that served during the [[Sith–Imperial War]] against the [[Fel Empire]]. In [[130 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nict]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] during the [[Battle of Caamas]], which saw the Alliance's surrender. Nict subsequently took up the invitation of Alliance Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] to refuse the orders to stand down, and the ''Pride of Corellia'' formed up on the position of Stazi's [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|flagship]]. However, while the latter admiral was sending to the ''Pride of Corellia'' a set of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump coordinates for them to use to escape, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial warships]] opened fire on Stazi's force, destroying Nict's [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].

==Description==
The ''Pride of Corellia''<ref name="Legacy21" /> was a [[YZ-2500 heavy transport]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="YZ" /> Sharing a name with<ref name="Legacy21" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> it was equipped with three [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and was armed with<ref name="Legacy21" /> a double medium [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery and two [[Heavy laser cannon/Legends|heavy laser cannons]]. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-sized<ref name="YZ" /> [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was also outfitted with a [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holotransceiver]].<ref name="Legacy21" />

==History==
{{Quote|Admiral Stazi, the ''Pride of Corellia'' is gone!|Captain Jaius Yorub|<ref name="Legacy21" />}}
The ''Pride of Corellia'' was in service of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]], fought between the Alliance and the [[Fel Empire]].<ref name="Legacy21" /> In [[130 ABY]],<ref name="130 ABY" /> the ''Pride of Corellia'', under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nict]], was among the Galactic Alliance [[Starship/Legends|starships]] fighting against [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial forces]] in a [[Battle of Caamas|battle]] at<ref name="Legacy21" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. After the Alliance<ref name="Legacy21" /> [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]]<ref name="Legacy20">[[Legacy (2006) 20|''Legacy'' (2006) 20]]</ref> [[Piers Petan]] negotiated their government's surrender to the Empire during the battle and ordered all Alliance ships to stand down, Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Core Fleet|Alliance Core Fleet]]&mdash;an old friend of Nict's&mdash;refused to comply with the order. He then invited any Alliance forces similarly disinclined to surrender to form up on the position of his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|''Indomitable'']], with the ''Pride of Corellia'' being one of the vessels to take up the offer.<ref name="Legacy21" />

[[File:Prideofcorelliadestroyed.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The destruction of the ''Pride of Corellia'']]
Nict then established [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] communication with the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Indomitable'', inquiring as to Stazi's plan of action. The defiant admiral instructed Nict to prepare their ship for a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump as the former was sending to the ''Pride of Corellia'' a set of jump coordinates utilizing a minor [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]]. Meanwhile, however, Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]], having learned of Stazi's refusal to surrender, ordered that Admiral [[Dru Valan]] command all Imperial vessels to destroy the Core Fleet so as to make an example of it. The Imperial ships opened heavy fire, and the ''Pride of Corellia'' was destroyed before the rest of the Alliance forces rallied around the ''Indomitable'' escaped to hyperspace. [[137 ABY|Seven years]] later, during a [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] against a [[Outer Rim Third Fleet|force]] commanded by Valan over the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], Stazi experienced a flashback to the events immediately leading up to and including the destruction of the ''Pride of Corellia''.<ref name="Legacy21" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Pride of Corellia'' was introduced in a flashback scene in the [[Legacy (2006) 21|twenty-first issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], pencilled by [[Omar Francia]],<ref name="Legacy21" /> and published on [[March 12]], [[2008]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54393/star_wars_legacy_2006_21|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #21}}</ref>
